description: Ex-Transbrasil Boeing 767-200 bought for an unrealised restaurant project and parked beside Avenida Elmo Serejo since about 2013; a famous derelict city landmark, fenced and under camera surveillance, cleaned of graffiti by volunteers in Sept 2025. Registration PT-TAC per the Feb 2026 compilation (press does not state it). Viewable from the street only.
